reader_question: How does a graph node's on-screen radius change as its entry count grows?
text_summary: Both curves are the real radius(node) formula from VAULT_GRAPH_SPEC.md §3, evaluated at entries = 0..40 in steps of 4 — not measured or sampled data, the exact function that will govern the shipped graph. radius = band_min + (band_max - band_min) * sqrt(clamp(entries, 0, cap) / cap). Project nodes range 12–20px (cap 40 entries); sub nodes range 8–14px (same cap). The square root keeps growth front-loaded: a node's radius reaches ~71% of its full range by 20 entries (half the cap), and the cap means a 40-entry node and an 80-entry node render identically — entry count differentiates small nodes from large ones, it does not linearly dominate the canvas.
title: Graph node radius vs. entry count
subtitle: VAULT_GRAPH_SPEC.md §3 — project and sub-node size bands, cap = 40 entries
